description.value: A community public library in Chetwynd, a small town on the Alaska Highway corridor in northern BC. The library offers computer and internet access, meeting rooms, printing and scanning services, and a wide range of programs. Chetwynd is known as the 'Chainsaw Sculpture Capital of the World,' and the library serves as a good rest stop and information point for cyclists passing through the Peace Region.

address.value: 4522 North Access Road, Chetwynd, BC V0C 1J0

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active public library on the Alaska Highway corridor offering free Wi-Fi, computer access, and a climate-controlled rest space — a practical stop for touring cyclists in a remote northern BC community.

blurb: Chetwynd's public library, an easy stop in the chainsaw-carving town.
